metadata.description:
Custom Nintendo DS Roms

Plays well with Keyboard and Mouse, Touchscreen,  Controllers with touchpad support &/or The Official PS4 Controller

Check Out Cop The Recruit, Mario Kart, New Super Mario Bros, Race Driver: Grid, Brain Age, Pokémon Diamond, Platinum, White, White 2, Heart Gold & GTA Chinatown Wars 

A Few Racing Games from the original ds Catalog only allow you to Drive Properly at Bumper Camera or have Bad Car Handling.
